en.sayed-ali-raza: Your allegiance to me was not without thinking, [1]
nor is my and your position the same. I seek you for Allāh’s sake but you seek me for your own benefits.
O people! support me despite your heart’s desires.
By Allāh, I will take revenge for the oppressed from the oppressor and will put a string in the nose of the oppressor and drag him to the spring of truthfulness even though he may grudge it.
